sha256-fd-v1:0779bb8e01c71abf57a2a19a725.description: Escape Jaffar's palace dungeons and reach the imprisoned princess before time runs out. Precise jumps, traps, guard fights, and rotoscoped movement define this cinematic platformer.
sha256-fd-v1:0779bb8e01c71abf57a2a19a725.title: Prince of Persia

sha256-fd-v1:07856ffe7b53f0a82dca4d702a0.description: Move and fight through a surreal fantasy RPG by learning its unusual keyboard commands. Encounters become typing challenges, making touch-typing skill as important as character progress.
sha256-fd-v1:07856ffe7b53f0a82dca4d702a0.title: Qumdole no Ken: Master the Blind touch

sha256-hdi-v1:0740cd933c3742d1809de04b6d.description: A psychological horror RPG made with Dante98. A choice at a train platform leads the protagonist into an uncanny carriage, where checking passengers' tickets becomes part of a disturbing journey.
sha256-hdi-v1:0740cd933c3742d1809de04b6d.title: Azusa 999

sha256-hdi-v1:074a694ad60463a98f29b474f1.description: Luna pursues the truth behind a laboratory disaster and her sister's disappearance. Experimental bioloader armor and Val-Kaizer draw her into a fast-moving science-fiction action story.
sha256-hdi-v1:074a694ad60463a98f29b474f1.title: Cyber Arms Val-Kaizer

sha256-hdi-v1:07ef1aa968a00eb4132e9e0fcd.description: Lime returns in a short animated adventure divided into three areas that can be visited in any order. Story scenes carry most of the episode, with limited interaction.
sha256-hdi-v1:07ef1aa968a00eb4132e9e0fcd.title: Jewel Bem Hunter Lime Vol. 02
